files.purpose_guess: Volunteer potting-on log for production year Aug 2024 to Jul 2025: monthly session sheets of plants potted into PB3 per species, rolled up on Summary against a goal taken from Helen Master.

sheets.name: Summary
sheets.grain: one species for the production year: goal set, T28 deduction, total to pot on, running total potted, remainder, plus one column per month pulled from the month sheets

columns.notes: Row number
98 species in rows 4-101; 101 distinct text values include totals labels
Entirely empty

=VLOOKUP($B4,'Helen Master'!$B$4:$J$93,9,false): pulls column J (Annual Projection, best case = 2 x column I) from Helen Master. 14 rows are hard-coded 0 instead, none of which match a Helen Master name
Hand-typed deduction for fast species grown in T28 (flax, toetoe, carex secta): 4 species, total 2070
=D-E on every row; total 10850
=sum(J:U) across months; total 8800
=F-G; 20 species are negative (potted more than goal)
=Aug!C4 etc; one column per month. May-July (S-U) are unused (one stray formula each in the totals row only). Apr column is all zero

formulas.pattern: monthly totals, cumulative total, GOAL =11000/9 per month, cumulative goal, over/under

quality_issues.issue: Goal VLOOKUP range 'Helen Master'!B4:J93 uses exact match; 15 Summary species have no exact match in Helen Master (e.g. Chionochloa conspicua, Podocarpus totara, Coprosma brunea); 14 have a hard-coded goal of 0 and so are potted with no goal. The 15th, Plagianthus regius, still shows a cached goal of 520 although the Helen Master name differs by a non-breaking space (D-cell cached value; behaviour unclear)

Is the 'TARGET' label on Annual for 2020/21 correct and where are 2021/22 and 2022/23?
